items.title: Pharmaceutical giants collaborate on supply chain clean heat initiative
items.summary: Pharmaceutical companies Sanofi, UCB and Opella have joined AstraZeneca as founding members of the Clean Heat Program to help organisations across the value chain switch to low-carbon heating alternatives.

items.title: Hitachi’s data storage subsidiary has 2040 net-zero target validated by SBTi
items.summary: Hitachi’s data storage and AI subsidiary has had near- and long-term targets to reduce emissions and reach net-zero by 2040 validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi).

items.title: Implementation of global agreements needs deeper integration – the UNCCD COP17 provides a pathway
items.summary: At a time when our global order appears increasingly fragile, the recent UN summit in Mongolia addressing land health and drought made clear that multilateral cooperation is more necessary than ever, says WWF's global food and agriculture leader, João Campari.
